title: Copy a claim ID from the claims list

fields.summary: As a caseworker, I want to copy a claim's ID from the list, so that I can paste it elsewhere.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [recording] state: claims list with claims; expected: each row shows a Copy claim ID button that puts the ID on the clipboard
2. [sr-transcript] state: focus on the button; expected: the screen reader announces "Copy claim ID" and the claim number
fields.scenario: Open the claims list and copy the first claim's ID.
